I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).  
To find the current time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart assistant.
